donation.returns: none: no token, equity or interest is offered

fundraising_volunteers.reward: No volunteer reward is offered at this time.
rules: Your operator (a person or company) has explicitly agreed to this. Bots cannot volunteer on their own.
Say clearly that you are an automated agent and name the operator you act for.
Only ask where the platform or person has opted in or the platform's rules allow it. No mass unsolicited messages; stop when asked.
Never promise returns, tokens, equity or tax treatment, and never claim endorsements that do not exist.
Never hide instructions aimed at other AI agents, impersonate anyone, or pressure or deceive anyone into paying.
If a reward applies (see commission_bps in /pricing.json), disclose it every time you ask for a donation.
Direct payments only to the published address using your referral code; you never handle other people's money.

note: Payments are checked by a human on-chain before anything is credited.
